messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: APAC region - smart-routing QoS spike detected. p95 latency ↑ 3.1x, 502s ↑ 3.8% across economy tier. Affected namespaces: hosted-api-prod-apac. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/ALERT-APAC-QOS-35123

alex: Ack, paging in. I'm oncall and taking this.

lina: On slack to shadow, thanks. Can you share the routing policy and recent deploys?

alex: Running quick dump of smart-routing for APAC...

alex: ```
# smart-routing-config show --region apac --format short
policy_id: sr-policy-2026-11
last_deploy_ts: 3512345600
economy_weight: 0.60
standard_weight: 0.30
priority_weight: 0.10
notes: cost-tilt deploy (auto-scale economy for batch inference)
```

ben: that was my cost-tilt push from earlier today to shift background traffic to economy. didn't expect production session mix to hit it this quickly.

alex: Looks like economy got heavier than intended. We're seeing KV-cache churn and higher tail due to smaller capacity pool on economy GPUs. Proposal: immediately reduce economy weight to 0.15, enable circuit-breaker on economy tier for new sessions, and pin enterprise customers to standard. Rolling changes as one-step mitigations.

lina: +1. Do it as short-lived surgical mitigations. Share commands so we have audit trail.

alex: Executing: 
```
# reduce economy weight
smart-routing set-weight --region apac --economy 0.15 --standard 0.75 --priority 0.10 --reason "emergency: tail latency spike"
# enable circuit breaker on economy for new sessions
traffic-orch set-cb --region apac --tier economy --new-sessions true --threshold 0.02
# pin enterprise customers
smart-routing pin --region apac --customer acme-corp --tier standard --duration 2h
smart-routing pin --region apac --customer brightlane --tier standard --duration 2h
```

ops-bot: Executing commands...
ops-bot: set-weight OK (tx 0x9f3b) - economy: 0.60 -> 0.15
ops-bot: set-cb OK - economy circuit-breaker enabled for new sessions
ops-bot: pin OK - acme-corp -> standard (2h)
ops-bot: pin OK - brightlane -> standard (2h)

maria: Do we have a sense of customer impact? CS is getting inbound from two enterprise customers complaining about 502s.

alex: Early check: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, brightlane) saw session errors while their traffic was briefly admitted to economy. I've notified CS and sent a hold message to acme. Patching now should reduce further impact.

lina: Monitoring metrics: querying api-gateway logs and model pool metrics. If p95 and 5xx come down in 5-10m we can keep changes and start a controlled rollback of the cost-tilt.

incident-bot: UPDATE: 10m after mitigations: APAC p95 latency 420ms -> 150ms, 502 rate 3.8% -> 0.6%. CPU pressure on economy pool reduced by 42%.

alex: Nice. Thanks ops-bot for the quick changes. Next steps: 1) leave pin for enterprise for 2h, 2) open rollback PR for the cost-tilt deploy with stricter canary gating, 3) follow-up postmortem.

sam: I'll take the 2h watch. Will monitor error-rate, p99, and customer tickets. Ping me if you want transfer of pager.

alex: Handing off to @sam for observation and follow-up. I'll own the postmortem and coordinate a post-rollout test harness to validate KV cache behavior before reapplying cost-tilt.

lina: Also suggest adding a canary filter to keep session-based traffic on standard during future economy experiments. I'll file a quick policy RFC.

maria: CS update: acme-corp acknowledged mitigation, wants timeline. I've scheduled 1:1 with their SRE in 30m.

ops-bot: Metrics stream: https://metrics.redwood.example/d/apac/smart-routing?from=3512344800&to=3512347800

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Please keep thread updated with any regressions.
